title: 城市糖果传奇的风格
prompt: A colorful, playful 2D map of [city name], in the style of Candy Crush Saga, featuring the city’s iconic landmarks as candy-inspired buildings, cute gumdrop trees, licorice bridges, pastel roads, and glossy water elements, floating clouds, vibrant cartoon style, top-down view, kid-friendly game aesthetics, horizontal layout
description: 使用 Nano Banana Pro 模型，轻松创作色彩缤纷、充满童趣的 2D 城市地图，采用《糖果传奇》风格，适合游戏素材、卡通建筑和趣味标志设计，打造糖果主题地标，带来生动活泼的视觉效果。
